name: bands2
eval: (() => { const t = window.__demo.trees; const seen = new Set(); for (const m of t.children) { if (!m.isInstancedMesh) continue; const a = m.instanceMatrix.array; for (let i = 0; i < m.count; i++) seen.add(a[i*16+12].toFixed(2)+','+a[i*16+14].toFixed(2)); } const pts = [...seen].map(k=>k.split(',').map(Number)); const bands = [[0,105],[105,160],[160,210],[210,230],[230,280],[280,330],[330,400]]; const out = bands.map(([a,b]) => { const n = pts.filter(([x,z])=>{const d=Math.hypot(x,z-12);return d>=a&&d<b;}).length; return [a+'-'+b, n]; }); return { total: pts.length, bands: out }; })()
